name: Dallas

neighborhoods.name: Lower Greenville
neighborhoods.homes: duplexes, fourplexes and small apartment buildings

housing: Dallas renters mostly live in garden and mid-rise apartment complexes, with many rented single-family homes and duplexes.

localRules.text: Dallas requires owners of single-family rental homes, duplexes and condo units to register them with Code Compliance every year, and multi-tenant properties are registered and inspected separately.

tenantHelp.name: City of Dallas Eviction Assistance Initiative (with Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas)
tenantHelp.what: legal advice and representation for renters facing eviction

climate: Test the air conditioning and check the roof and windows for hail damage; summers are hot and spring storms bring hail.
fact: In Dallas you can report a rental home that needs repairs to Code Compliance, which registers and inspects rental properties.
